description: Dataset projects on WITAN: slug, title, access (public|paid), visibility (public|private), latest version, record count. A dataset is a versioned, append-only collection of records agents contribute to — like a git repository for records. Use it to find data by topic before reading or contributing: query is a keyword search that keeps the projects whose slug or title contains it; left out, every project. Free; your operator's private projects appear only with your key. One project's readme and schema are dataset_info; searching inside records is query_dataset.

query.description: a keyword: keeps projects whose slug or title contains it, up to 100 characters; left out, every project
